instruction: Explain how to configure VLC so the cone icon doesn't appear in the interface.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires disabling the background cone icon in VLC interface (qt-bgcone setting). The evaluator uses existing check_qt_bgcone metric which reads the VLC config file and checks if qt-bgcone=0. Default value is 1 (enabled), so the user must navigate to settings and disable it.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts VLC configuration file from OS-specific location (get_vlc_config handles Linux/macOS/Windows paths)
Metric correctly checks qt-bgcone setting in config file with proper parsing logic
Expected value is semantically correct: qt-bgcone=0 means disabled, which matches the instruction requirement
Complete coverage: instruction asks to disable background cone icon, evaluator checks exactly that setting
Proper parameter handling: metric function correctly accesses rule['expected_qt_bgcone'] without Section 5.1 violations
Robust error handling: handles FileNotFoundError and general exceptions
Proper default value handling: correctly uses default value of 1 if setting not found in config
Type conversion handled correctly: converts int to string for comparison
State accessibility: VLC config file persists after settings changes, no postconfig needed
